newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares end quiet week mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares end quiet week mostly steady.

text.p: Shares on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market ended the week to Thursday mostly steady in slow trade in the first week of the new year, dealers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index rose just over five points to 2,492.34 from 2,486.93.
The dealers said quiet trading was limited to few shares of banks and some companies.
The Commercial Bank of Dubai shares climbed two dirhams to 60 dirhams. NBAD shares were five dirhams firmer, closing at 450. Emirates Insurance Company shares gained 10 dirhams to 630 dirhams.
Abu Dhabi National Hotels Co lost 10 dirhams to 1,035.
Most other traded shares were flat.
